description: As a crew scheduler, I want to verify that assigned crew members hold the required certifications before confirming an assignment.

acs.text: System checks crew member's certification status against flight requirements.
Expired certifications trigger a block with reason displayed.
Override allowed by supervisor role with audit log entry.

questions: Q-SAA009-001: AC-1 does not define what 'required certifications' are or where they are stored. Is there a certification matrix per aircraft type?

sections.content: The crew certification API endpoint is /api/v2/crew/{id}/certifications. Response includes: cert_type, issued_date, expiry_date, status. Use Bearer token for auth.
Certification must be valid at the time of flight departure, not at the time of assignment. Grace period: 48 hours after expiry for domestic flights only.

comments.author: Tech Lead
comments.body: Note: TEST-SAA-010 (certification data sync) is still in development. The API endpoint may change.
